description:
XMLForge is a simple and powerful XML formatter & attribute reordering tool for Android.
Features:
• Formats XML with proper indentation
• Reorders attributes in a structured way
• Supports Android XML files
• One-click copy to clipboard
• Simple and intuitive UI
How It Works
• Paste or load your XML content.
• Tap the Format button to clean up the structure.
• View the formatted output with attributes ordered correctly.
• Copy the formatted XML with a single tap.
